image_description: A Gothic-style stone altar situated within a vaulted sanctuary. The altar features a raised rectangular table structure with an ornate, carved stone reredos (back panel) featuring blind arches and decorative molding. It is flanked by tall stained-glass windows and sits beneath a ribbed stone vault ceiling. The lighting is dim, creating high contrast between the illuminated windows and the shadowed stone architecture.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The lead lines in the stained glass windows show slight irregularities and 'melting' where they intersect, lacking the crisp straightness of real lead caming. This is a common AI artifact in complex grid patterns.

The intersection points of the ribbed vaults in the upper center are slightly ambiguous and soft, lacking the precise geometric convergence seen in real masonry. Some ribs appear to fade into the background rather than connecting cleanly.
The vertical mullions of the right-hand window exhibit a very slight wobble or curvature, deviating from the expected rigid straight lines of stone window frames.
